notes.title: TANGLEWOOD Patch 1.03 is now LIVE!
notes.content:
Patch 1.03 is now live, which provides the following improvements:

[list]
    [*]Save history feature - allows you to backtrack to a previous save game
    [*]Password entry feature - allows for sharing saved games between Mega Drive and PC versions
    [*]Save Mega Drive ROM feature - allows for exporting the ROM file to a location of your choice (to play via emulator or flash cartridge)
    [*]Startup fix for latest Ubuntu and Mint Linux distributions
[/list]

The patch applies to both the full game and the demo.

Please let us know if you have any problems!

Matt <3

notes.title: Minor update - Linux startup issues
notes.content:
We've pushed a minor patch to address problems with the game starting up on very recent Linux distributions - Ubuntu 18.04 and Mint Beta (Cinnamon).

The change includes an updated stdc++ runtime library, and a missing PNG image library.

Please let me know if you experience any other issues!

Matt <3

notes.title: Patch 1.02 News
notes.content:
Hi!

We're preparing Patch 1.02, which will contain the following changes:

[list]
    [*]Fix for startup crash on stock, minimal Ubuntu 18.04.1 LTS installation
    [*]Password entry option for PC builds, allowing you to share your save games between PC and Mega Drive
    [*]Save Mega Drive ROM tool to make it easier to extract ROM file
    [*]Place cursor on 'Continue' option by default if save data is available
[/list]

We'll let you know when it's live! In the meantime, if you're experiencing any problems, please let us know ASAP and we'll add them to the next patch list.

Cheers,
Matt <3

notes.title: TANGLEWOOD Demo and Patch 1.01 - now LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[h1]Patch 1.01[/h1]

A patch has just gone live, which addresses the following:

[list]
    [*]Fixed a startup crash on Windows 7 with video drivers missing the glMapBufferRangeARB extension
    [*]Fixed Windows 10 high DPI scaling feature causing the game window to be the wrong size, or in the wrong position
    [*]Fixed a bug causing the "So Long and Thanks for all the Fish" achievement to not trigger
    [*]Fixed a bug on Windows 10 causing the game window to draw behind the taskbar in some screen resolutions
    [*]The TANGLEWOOD Mega Drive game manual is now included in PDF format along with the ROM
[/list]

Thank you for everyone's patience while we tracked down the problems, please do let me know in the Discussions section if you experience any more issues, or email help@tanglewoodgame.com.

[h1]TANGLEWOOD Demo[/h1]

Our demo has been approved by Valve, and is now LIVE!

The demo includes the complete first chapter of TANGLEWOOD, and also includes the demo ROM file for you to try the game on your genuine SEGA console (via flash cart) or your favourite emulator.

The demo also includes all fixes from patch 1.01.


We hope everyone is enjoying the game, and thank you so so much for the kind reviews!

Matt <3

notes.title: Patch 1.01 and Steam Demo News
notes.content:
Hello, TANGLEWOOD fans!

[h1]Known Issues to be fixed in Patch 1.01[/h1]

We've identified the following issues:

[olist]
    [*]Windows 7 users may experience a crash on startup due to a missing dependency
    [*]Windows 10 users with high DPI monitors may experience incorrect fullscreen resolutions or incorrect game draw position
[/olist]

A patch is being prepared and we hope for it to go live on the evening of Thursday 16th August.

Thank you for everyone's patience on this, and thank you for all info provided to help us track it down!

[h1]Steam Demo[/h1]

Valve have now approved our demo build for release. We're making preparations now (including updating it with Patch 1.01) and expect to release on the evening of Thrsday 16th August.


Cheers,

Matt <3
